mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Temperatures are a pleasant 70 degrees under clear skies at Badger Ridge Middle School. If you are an early riser, the space station will be visible tonight starting at 4:17 AM for four minutes, rising over the area near Verona High School in the northwest and traveling toward the east northeast in the direction of Fitchburg.

The Verona Senior Center has announced that they will be replacing flooring throughout their building beginning September 1. Please be aware that from September 1 to September 4, they will only be holding wellness appointments and outdoor programming, and the center will be closed entirely on September 7 for Labor Day.

Today, you can participate in Hop Haus Trivia or check out the Quizmasters Trivia at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the activities continue with yoga at Insight Wellness, the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.

In a noteworthy call from this past week, on August 25, officers were dispatched to a home on Enterprise Drive for a medical emergency where they successfully used an AED to help a patient regain a pulse.
Today's featured flavor is the decadent Chocolate Heath Crunch. Please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM, so you can stop by any time after that to enjoy a treat.
